{{NPC|Jolyne}} }} '''Fable Reef''' is a [[Locations|location]] that is unlocked after viewing [[Lance|Lance's]] 8-Heart cutscene. It is only accessible from two methods. First is the third warp rune in the [[Wizard's Tower|Wizard's Basement]]. Once viewing Lance's 10-Heart cutscene, a warp is created north of the [[Stardew:Island Farm|Island Farm]]. It has many exclusive fish and foragables that can be valuable. It is also home to the [[First Slash Guild House]], the headquarters of the [[The First Slash Clan]]. {{TOC}} ==[[File:First Slash Guild House.png|100px]][[First Slash Guild House]]== The [[First Slash Guild House]] can be found on the center of Fable Reef and is where the [[The First Slash Clan|Guild members]] congregate and meet. Within is a bedroom that can be used to sleep to end the day. ==Forage== Many foragables spawn here, including exclusive ones. The Tide Pools are located on the north end of the island, behind the Guild House.
